evidence: Regional lexical-family membership only: the existing user-approved māṭī husband family is grounded in three Mewari survey attestations and the Mewari dictionary entry माटी maʈi husband, Kapasan area. Selected Rajasthanic/Bhil māṭī/maṭi/mati husband forms share this regional stem and sense; vowel length and dental/retroflex notation remain explicit qualifications. The family head is an attested representative, not a reconstructed ancestor. Ultimate ancestry and regional transmission remain unresolved. Homonymous soil/clay forms do not justify a historical link; extended maṭidoṭlo and other compounds remain excluded.
